com.ibm.cos.v2.services.s3.internal

Class CustomRequestTransformerUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.services.s3.internal.CustomRequestTransformerUtils

  • public final class CustomRequestTransformerUtils
extends Object
    This class transforms specific request parameter into a custom parameter. The logic needed to construct parameters like copySource which is non-trivial, so this class facilitates the use of higher-level constructs that more closely match other APIs, such as PutObjectRequest.

    For more information, see: CopyObject Request Parameters
